description: Start Making a Reader Today (SMART®) is a low-cost Oregon school-based programme that provides volunteer one-on-one reading tutoring and free books to K–2 students at risk of reading failure.
title: SMART®

description: A school-based GCSE science revision programme developed by O'Hare and colleagues that combines SMART Materials, SMART Training, and SMART Activities to deliver spaced lessons in biology, chemistry, and physics.
title: SMART Spaces programme

description: SmartCoach and SurgSmart are AI-assisted surgical-coaching software systems that analyse laparoscopic simulation or procedural video to generate performance reports and feedback for surgeons and surgical trainees.
title: SmartCoach and SurgSmart

description: SMARTIES is an intelligent authoring system developed by Mizoguchi et al.
title: SMARTIES

description: A self-contained, AI-generated browser application developed by Josep Ll.
title: SmartPhysics: Rotation Lab

description: A simulated Python tutoring environment developed by Oluseyi Olukolaa for testing pedagogical safety and adaptive tutoring policies in educational reinforcement-learning systems.
title: SmartTutor

description: SMDEP is a free six-week residential science-enrichment programme run at 12 national sites for minority and socioeconomically disadvantaged undergraduates interested in medical or dental careers.
title: SMDEP

description: SmileyDiscovery is an ML-empowered scientific discovery learning tool developed by Jingwan Tang and colleagues that supports accessible multidimensional data exploration and k-means clustering for K–12 learners and teachers.
title: SmileyDiscovery

description: A framework developed by Susan Bull and colleagues that guides designers in specifying, comparing, evaluating, and describing open learner models and their learner-facing interfaces.
title: SMILI☺ framework: core questions for designing and describing open learner models
